purpose: Qualify q1 for a later full-corpus parent run by combining exact 100M parent preservation with phase-resolved resource headroom evidence, without claiming compression improvement.

population.selection: canonical enwik9 opening prefix from byte zero
population.identity_rule: The runner must independently hash exactly 100,000,000 bytes from the canonical 1G corpus before creating its result root; historical prefix metadata has no execution authority.

frozen_parent_and_candidate.unchanged_mechanism_rule: No predictor, probability, coder, preprocessing, allocator geometry, pageout policy, compiler, head, dictionary, package, or numeric parameter may change from sealed q1.

arms.role: uninstrumented q1 release resource and inverse arm

identity_observer_source.sealed_source_application: Exact --fuzz=0 patch application and frozen-definition syntax validation pass against the q1 source closure; the bound state-mutation harness also passes syntax validation; no observer build or execution receipt exists.
identity_observer_source.runtime_activation: GAMMA_FULL_IDENTITY_DIR must name an existing absolute output directory; absent activation leaves packaging/helper encoder runs observationally disabled.

observer_build.required_binary_identity: A and B are byte-identical within I-P and independently byte-identical within I-Q.
observer_build.negative_control: N-P is the parent observer compiled with GAMMA_FULL_IDENTITY_PRE_HEAD=1; its payload must remain identical to I-P while its probability digest must differ.
observer_build.state_mutation_control: Compile the bound harness against the copied observer header with one 4,096-byte semantic range; a one-byte XOR must change its range and aggregate digests, and the following unchanged terminal snapshot must match the mutation snapshot.
observer_build.package_rule: Package replicate A for I-P, I-Q, and N-P after within-arm identity passes; dictionary, article-order, and header payloads must match across all three.

fixed_runs: opening-10M I-P post-head with exact inverse
opening-10M I-Q post-head with exact inverse
opening-10M N-P pre-head with exact inverse
observer_calibration.reference_rule: Post-head digests and arithmetic payloads must reproduce the independently verified retained opening/distant 10M receipt. N-P must preserve the opening payload, state, transformed inverse, and raw inverse while producing a different probability digest.
observer_calibration.resource_rule: All five encodes and three opening decodes are sequential, single-CPU, guarded, and forbidden while an exclusive full-1G lease is active. Their memory is diagnostic only.

identity_observer.post_head_probability: Online SHA-256 of each exact uint16 probability after KhBitLstm32Head::Adjust and immediately before arithmetic range split; calibrate unchanged instrumentation against both retained 10M digests.
identity_observer.pre_head_negative_control: N-P hashes the uint16 probability immediately before KhBitLstm32Head::Adjust; its payload must equal I-P, while its digest must differ from the post-head I-P digest.
identity_observer.coder_checkpoints: Hash low/high range state, pending output state, coded-byte count, modeled-byte index, and decoded history at frozen checkpoints.
identity_observer.persistent_state: At each checkpoint, hash source-ordered requested semantic bytes for all 26 large FXCM allocations affected by q1; exclude virtual addresses, filenames, inode numbers, alignment padding, mapping slack, page residency, and fault history.
identity_observer.diagnostic_separation_rule: Full state hashing can fault file-backed pages into residency, so I-P/I-Q memory observations are diagnostic only and cannot establish R-Q headroom. R-Q must use the sealed release build without the identity observer.
required_equalities: I-P and I-Q post-head probability digests
I-P and I-Q coder checkpoint manifests
I-P and I-Q per-allocation persistent-state checkpoint manifests
I-P and I-Q payload bytes and SHA-256
I-P and I-Q decoded transformed output
I-P, I-Q, and R-Q exact 100M raw inverse

required_measurements: process-tree RSS peak and complete sample stream
largest per-process VmHWM and terminal process status
cgroup memory.current, memory.peak, memory.events, and memory.stat deltas
phase-specific smaps_rollup and named mapping totals
anonymous, file-backed, shmem, page-table, kernel, and cache attribution
scratch logical bytes, allocated bytes, filesystem type, and cleanup residue
logical CPU count, runnable threads, return codes, and phase markers
resource_observer.memory_high_is_not_a_pass: Reclaim pressure is permitted, but memory.high throttling cannot substitute for the measured process-tree, VmHWM, cgroup-peak, and event gates.

promotion_predicates: the observer calibration receipt and its independent verification both pass
canonical opening 100M identity is independently verified
I-P and I-Q exact post-head probability streams match
all rolling coder and complete persistent-state checkpoint manifests match
parent/q1 payloads and decoded transformed streams match
all required raw inverses are exact
R-Q process-tree peak is at most 9,000,000 KiB
R-Q cgroup peak is at most 10,000,000,000 bytes with zero max, OOM, and OOM-kill events
all phase, CPU, temporary-disk, return-code, and cleanup gates pass
every receipt and output manifest is independently rehashed and schema-valid

terminal_branches.pass: Authorize one unchanged full-1G q1 qualification run; award no compression or score credit.
terminal_branches.identity_failure: Locate the first rolling probability, coder, or persistent-state divergence and authorize one correction-only identity successor.
terminal_branches.identity_pass_resource_failure: Authorize one successor that changes only the exactly attributed high-water allocation or phase.
terminal_branches.headroom_failure_after_one_correction: Stop treating CMIX as the prize-facing substrate and move the primary lane to the compact open NNCP student.

forbidden: Launching while any exclusive full-1G lease is active
Using the already-running qm8 full-1G diagnostic as retroactive 100M promotion authority
Changing multiple semantic or residency axes in a rescue
Treating payload equality as probability or persistent-state identity
Treating instrumented-arm memory as release-arm resource authority
Awarding Gamma compression, authorship, or score credit
claim_boundary: A pass proves exact q1 parent preservation and engineering headroom on one frozen opening 100M population. It does not qualify full-1G behavior, two-run determinism, complete package score, official runtime, Gamma authorship, or compression improvement.
